def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    inners=[]  # (center_r, center_c, color)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==0 or seen[i][j]: continue
            # BFS component of color c
            stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+di,b+dj
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==c and not seen[x][y]:
                        seen[x][y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
            rs=[a for a,b in cells]; cs=[b for a,b in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if len(cells)==(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1):  # solid rectangle -> inner block
                inners.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2,c,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
    if not inners: return out
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(c for _,_,c,_ in inners)
    inert=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    from collections import defaultdict
    rows=defaultdict(list); cols=defaultdict(list)
    for cr,cc,c,_ in inners:
        if c==inert: continue
        rows[cr].append((cc,c)); cols[cc].append((cr,c))
    def paint(cells,col):
        for y,x in cells:
            if out[y][x]==0: out[y][x]=col
    for cr,cc,c,_ in inners:
        if c==inert: continue
        js=sorted(x for x,cc2 in rows[cr] if cc2==c)
        L=[x for x in js if x<cc]
        if L: paint([(cr,x) for x in range(L[-1]+1,cc)],c)
        R=[x for x in js if x>cc]
        if R: paint([(cr,x) for x in range(cc+1,R[0])],c)
        isr=sorted(x for x,rr in cols[cc] if rr==c)
        U=[x for x in isr if x<cr]
        if U: paint([(x,cc) for x in range(U[-1]+1,cr)],c)
        D=[x for x in isr if x>cr]
        if D: paint([(x,cc) for x in range(cr+1,D[0])],c)
    return out
